title: Social activity daily v1
description: Derived activity associated with canonical text-mentioned location strings, not verified physical origins or market demand. One row per UTC publication date and mentioned location. Counts distinct logical posts after deterministic latest-observation selection. A multi-location post contributes once to each distinct location. Null publication times and absent/empty location mentions are excluded. Unavailable engagement counters contribute zero to sums. Full rebuild replaces derived state; generated time is run metadata. Exact aliases of one place collapse before counting, once per logical post/place. Unmapped mentions retain their original name with null location_id.

activity_date.description: UTC calendar date from canonical published_at, never collected_at.

location_id.description: Shared named-place key for an exact text-mentioned alias; null for an unmapped mention. Never a verified post origin.

location_name.description: Accented catalog name for resolved text mentions; original detected string for an unmapped mention. Not a verified post origin.

post_count.description: Distinct logical record_id values contributing to this date/location after latest-observation selection.

engagement_total.description: Unweighted sum of the four aggregate engagement counters.

gold_generated_at.description: UTC Gold rebuild time, independent of publication/observation times.
